# AIRPORT CATERING AND MEAL SERVICE AGREEMENT

**AGREEMENT NUMBER:** APF-2026-CNS-0847

**EFFECTIVE DATE:** January 1, 2027

**EXPIRATION DATE:** December 31, 2031

---

## PARTIES TO THIS AGREEMENT

This Airport Catering and Meal Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between:

**GRANTOR:** Metropolitan Airport Authority of Greater Regions ("MAAGR"), a public benefit corporation established under the laws of the State, with administrative offices located at 10000 Airport Boulevard, Terminal Building, Suite 4500, City of Skyport, State 10001 ("Grantor" or "Airport Authority");

AND

**CONCESSIONAIRE:** Global Gastronomy Group LLC, a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware, with principal place of business at 789 Culinary Center Drive, Food Court Plaza, Chicago, Illinois 60601 ("Concessionaire" or "Caterer").

Collectively referred to herein as the "Parties" or individually as a "Party."

---

## RECITALS

**WHEREAS,** the Grantor operates Metropolitan International Airport ("Airport") including airline lounges, premium passenger areas, and airline catering facilities;

**WHEREAS,** certain airlines operating at the Airport require in-flight meal catering services and lounge catering for their passengers across all service classes;

**WHEREAS,** the Concessionaire represents it possesses the expertise, facilities, and capacity to provide in-flight meal catering services meeting aviation industry standards;

**NOW, THEREFORE,** the Parties agree as follows:

---

## ARTICLE I: DEFINITIONS

### Section 1.01: Defined Terms

**1.01.01** "Business Class Meals" shall mean premium meals served to passengers traveling in business class or equivalent premium cabin, meeting specifications in Exhibit A-1;

**1.01.02** "Economy Class Meals" shall mean standard meals served to passengers traveling in economy class or equivalent standard cabin, meeting specifications in Exhibit A-2;

**1.01.03** "First Class Meals" shall mean luxury meals served to passengers traveling in first class or equivalent luxury cabin, meeting specifications in Exhibit A-3;

**1.01.04** "Special Meals" shall mean meals prepared for passengers with dietary restrictions including but not limited to: vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, gluten-free, diabetic, child, infant, and allergy-specific meals as detailed in Exhibit A-4;

**1.01.05** "On-Time Delivery" shall mean delivery of meals to the aircraft or designated catering facility within the agreed time window as specified in Section 4.02;

**1.01.06** "Flight Delay" shall mean any delay to scheduled departure time exceeding fifteen (15) minutes as reported by the airline;

**1.01.07** "Load Factor" shall mean the percentage of seats occupied by passengers on a given flight;

**1.01.08** "Catering Window" shall mean the period beginning four (4) hours prior to scheduled departure and ending ninety (90) minutes prior to scheduled departure;

**1.01.09** "Meal Shortfall" shall mean the difference between ordered meals and delivered meals for any flight;

**1.01.10** "Quality Defect" shall mean any meal failing to meet specifications including but not limited to: incorrect temperature, damaged packaging, missing components, incorrect portion size, or spoilage;

**1.01.11** "Passenger Complaint" shall mean any formal complaint lodged by a passenger regarding meal quality, delivered through airline or Grantor complaint channels;

**1.01.12** "Critical Flight" shall mean any long-haul international flight exceeding eight (8) hours duration or any flight where meal service is a contractual obligation of the airline to passengers.

---

## ARTICLE II: MEAL SERVICE SPECIFICATIONS

### Section 2.01: Business Class Meal Specifications

(a) **Minimum Standards:**
   - Appetizer: Two (2) courses, minimum 150g combined weight
   - Main Course: Three (3) options, minimum 350g each, premium protein required
   - Dessert: Two (2) options, minimum 120g each
   - Bread Service: Minimum three (3) varieties, artisanal quality
   - Beverage pairing available upon request

(b) **Presentation Requirements:**
   - China dinnerware or approved equivalent
   - Metal cutlery (no plastic)
   - Cloth napkins
   - Individual plating or approved cart presentation

(c) **Pricing:** As specified in Exhibit B-1, subject to annual adjustment per Section 3.04

### Section 2.02: Economy Class Meal Specifications

(a) **Minimum Standards:**
   - Main Course: Two (2) options, minimum 280g each
   - Side Item: One (1) item (bread, fruit, or salad)
   - Dessert: One (1) item, minimum 80g
   - Beverage: Complimentary non-alcoholic, alcoholic available for purchase

(b) **Presentation Requirements:**
   - Approved disposable or reusable containers
   - Single-use cutlery (biodegradable preferred)
   - Napkin included

(c) **Pricing:** As specified in Exhibit B-2, subject to annual adjustment per Section 3.04

### Section 2.03: First Class Meal Specifications

(a) **Minimum Standards:**
   - Appetizer: Three (3) courses, premium ingredients required
   - Main Course: Five (5) options including premium cuts (lobster, wagyu beef, etc.)
   - Dessert: Three (3) options, prepared by on-board chef if flight exceeds 10 hours
   - Bread Service: Five (5) varieties with premium butter service
   - Amuse-bouche: One (1) item
   - Cheese cart service for flights exceeding six (6) hours

(b) **Presentation Requirements:**
   - Premium china and glassware
   - Silver cutlery
   - Linen table service where operationally feasible
   - On-board finishing service for flights exceeding eight (8) hours

(c) **Pricing:** As specified in Exhibit B-3, subject to annual adjustment per Section 3.04

### Section 2.04: Special Meal Requirements

(a) **Advance Notice Periods:**
   - Standard special meals (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free): 24 hours
   - Religious meals (halal, kosher): 48 hours
   - Medical/dietary restriction meals: 48 hours
   - Infant/child meals: 24 hours

(b) **Minimum Availability:**
   - At least two (2) special meal options available on every flight
   - Special meals shall not be substituted without passenger consent except in force majeure

(c) **Pricing:** As specified in Exhibit B-4

---

## ARTICLE III: PRICING AND PAYMENT

### Section 3.01: Base Meal Rates

| Meal Category | Base Rate (USD) | Annual Escalation |
|---------------|-----------------|-------------------|
| Business Class | $28.50 - $42.00 | 3.5% |
| Economy Class | $12.75 - $18.50 | 2.5% |
| First Class | $55.00 - $85.00 | 4.0% |
| Special Meals | Cost + 15% | 3.0% |
| Crew Meals | $11.25 | 2.0% |

Detailed pricing schedules attached in Exhibit B.

### Section 3.02: Volume Discounts

Concessionaire shall provide volume discounts as follows:

| Annual Meal Volume | Discount |
|--------------------|----------|
| 500,000 - 1,000,000 meals | 2.5% |
| 1,000,001 - 2,000,000 meals | 4.0% |
| 2,000,001 - 5,000,000 meals | 6.0% |
| Above 5,000,000 meals | 8.0% |

### Section 3.03: Payment Terms

(a) Invoices submitted monthly, due within thirty (30) days
(b) Late payment penalty: 1.5% per month
(c) Disputed amounts: Payable within fifteen (15) days of resolution

### Section 3.04: Annual Price Adjustment

Prices shall be adjusted annually on January 1 based on:
(a) Consumer Price Index for Urban Consumers (CPI-U) Food category
(b) Jet fuel price index (for transportation costs)
(c) Local market wage rates for food service workers

## ARTICLE IV: KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

### Section 4.01: KPI Framework

Concessionaire performance measured against fifteen (15) Key Performance Indicators. Each KPI includes specific targets, measurement methodology, and penalty structure.

### Section 4.02: KPI-1: On-Time Delivery Performance

**Definition:** Percentage of flights where meals delivered within Catering Window

**Target:** ≥ 98.5% on-time delivery

**Measurement:** 
- Delivery timestamp recorded at aircraft door or catering facility
- Time compared against scheduled departure minus 90 minutes
- Data source: Airport logistics system and Concessionaire delivery logs

**Scoring:**
| Performance | Score | Consequence |
|-------------|-------|-------------|
| ≥ 99.5% | 110 | Eligible for bonus |
| 98.5% - 99.4% | 100 | No action |
| 97.0% - 98.4% | 75 | Warning |
| 95.0% - 96.9% | 50 | Penalty Tier 1 |
| < 95.0% | 25 | Penalty Tier 2 + CAP |

**Penalty Structure:**
- Tier 1 (95.0% - 96.9%): $2,500 per percentage point below 97%
- Tier 2 (< 95.0%): $5,000 per percentage point below 97% + Corrective Action Plan

**Example:** If on-time delivery = 94.2%, penalty = $5,000 × (97 - 94.2) = $14,000

### Section 4.03: KPI-2: Meal Delivery Time Accuracy

**Definition:** Meals must arrive no earlier than 4 hours and no later than 90 minutes before scheduled departure

**Target:** 100% within window

**Measurement:** Delivery timestamp vs. scheduled departure time

**Penalty Structure:**
| Violation Type | Penalty Per Flight |
|----------------|-------------------|
| Early delivery (>4 hours before departure) | $500 |
| Late delivery (<90 minutes before departure) | $1,500 |
| Critical delay (meal arrives after aircraft departure) | $5,000 + meal cost refund |
| Repeated late delivery (3+ times in 30 days, same route) | $10,000 + mandatory review |

### Section 4.04: KPI-3: Order Fulfillment Rate

**Definition:** Percentage of ordered meals successfully delivered

**Target:** ≥ 99.5% fulfillment

**Penalty Structure:**
| Shortfall Category | Penalty |
|--------------------|---------|
| 1-5 meals short | $75 per meal + refund |
| 6-20 meals short | $150 per meal + refund |
| 21-50 meals short | $300 per meal + refund + $2,500 administrative penalty |
| 51+ meals short | $500 per meal + refund + $10,000 administrative penalty |
| >10% of order short on Critical Flight | $25,000 + immediate review |

**Additional Provisions:**
- Passengers entitled to meal refunds processed within 48 hours
- Airlines entitled to compensation for passenger complaints
- Repeated shortfalls (3+ incidents per quarter) trigger contract review

### Section 4.05: KPI-4: Meal Quality Score

**Definition:** Composite score from passenger feedback, airline feedback, and quality audits

**Target:** ≥ 4.5/5.0 average score

**Measurement:**
- Passenger surveys (40% weighting)
- Airline crew feedback (30% weighting)
- Monthly quality audits (30% weighting)

**Penalty Structure:**
| Average Score | Monthly Penalty |
|---------------|-----------------|
| 4.5 - 5.0 | None |
| 4.0 - 4.49 | $5,000 |
| 3.5 - 3.99 | $15,000 |
| 3.0 - 3.49 | $30,000 + CAP |
| < 3.0 | $50,000 + contract review |

### Section 4.06: KPI-5: Special Meal Availability

**Definition:** Percentage of special meal requests fulfilled correctly

**Target:** ≥ 99.0%

**Penalty Structure:**
| Failure Type | Penalty |
|--------------|---------|
| Standard special meal not available (24hr notice given) | $250 per incident + meal cost |
| Religious/medical meal not available (48hr notice given) | $750 per incident + meal cost + $500 passenger compensation |
| Wrong special meal delivered | $150 per incident |
| Allergen error (non-life-threatening) | $2,500 + CAP |
| Allergen error (medical intervention required) | $25,000 + immediate suspension |

### Section 4.07: KPI-6: Temperature Compliance

**Definition:** Percentage of meals meeting temperature safety standards at time of service

**Standards:**
- Hot meals: ≥ 140°F (60°C) at time of service
- Cold meals: ≤ 41°F (5°C) at time of service
- Reheated meals: ≥ 165°F (74°C) internal temperature

**Target:** 100% compliance

**Penalty Structure:**
| Violation Severity | Penalty |
|--------------------|---------|
| Single temperature violation | $500 + meal replacement |
| Pattern of violations (5+ per month) | $10,000 + audit |
| Temperature violation causing illness | $50,000 + suspension + liability |
| Willful temperature standard violation | $100,000 + termination consideration |

### Section 4.08: KPI-7: Food Safety Incident Rate

**Definition:** Number of confirmed foodborne illness incidents per million meals served

**Target:** Zero incidents

**Penalty Structure:**
| Incident Type | Penalty |
|---------------|---------|
| Suspected foodborne illness (under investigation) | Flight hold + $5,000 provisional |
| Confirmed foodborne illness (single passenger) | $25,000 + full investigation |
| Confirmed foodborne illness (multiple passengers) | $100,000 + suspension |
| Hospitalization required | $250,000 + immediate suspension |
| Fatal outcome | $1,000,000 + termination + legal action |

**Additional Requirements:**
- All incidents reported to health department within 4 hours
- Concessionaire maintains product samples for 72 hours
- Full traceability required for all ingredients

### Section 4.09: KPI-8: Load Factor Flexibility

**Definition:** Ability to accommodate load factor changes requested by airline

**Requirements:**
| Notice Period | Required Accommodation |
|---------------|----------------------|
| ≥ 4 hours before departure | 100% of change |
| 2-4 hours before departure | 90% of change |
| 1-2 hours before departure | 75% of change |
| < 1 hour before departure | Best efforts |

**Penalty Structure:**
| Failure Type | Penalty |
|--------------|---------|
| Unable to accommodate ≥4 hour notice | $50 per meal + lost profit |
| Unable to accommodate 2-4 hour notice | $35 per meal + lost profit |
| Refusal without valid cause | $500 per incident |

### Section 4.10: KPI-9: Waste Rate

**Definition:** Percentage of prepared meals not served (wasted)

**Target:** ≤ 3.5% waste rate

**Measurement:** (Total prepared - Total served) / Total prepared

**Incentive/penalty structure:**
| Waste Rate | Consequence |
|------------|-------------|
| ≤ 2.5% | 1% bonus on monthly invoice |
| 2.51% - 3.5% | No action |
| 3.51% - 5.0% | Warning |
| 5.01% - 7.0% | $2,500 per month |
| > 7.0% | $10,000 per month + CAP |

### Section 4.11: KPI-10: Passenger Complaint Rate

**Definition:** Number of passenger complaints per 10,000 meals served

**Target:** ≤ 5 complaints per 10,000 meals

**Penalty Structure:**
| Complaint Rate | Monthly Penalty |
|----------------|-----------------|
| 0-5 per 10,000 | None |
| 6-10 per 10,000 | $2,500 |
| 11-20 per 10,000 | $7,500 + CAP |
| 21+ per 10,000 | $20,000 + review |

**Complaint Categories (weighted):**
- Taste/quality complaint: 1.0×
- Portion size complaint: 0.5×
- Packaging complaint: 0.5×
- Allergen/dietary error: 5.0×
- Spoilage complaint: 3.0×

### Section 4.12: KPI-11: Crew Meal Compliance

**Definition:** Availability and quality of crew meals

**Requirements:**
- Crew meals available on all flights > 4 hours
- Minimum 1 crew meal per 2 crew members
- Delivery 30 minutes before crew report time

**Penalty Structure:**
| Violation | Penalty |
|-----------|---------|
| Crew meal not available | $100 per missing meal |
| Crew meal late | $50 per meal + $25 inconvenience |
| Crew meal quality defect | $75 per meal |

### Section 4.13: KPI-12: Documentation Accuracy

**Definition:** Accuracy of meal manifests, allergen declarations, and nutritional information

**Target:** 100% accuracy

**Penalty Structure:**
| Error Type | Penalty |
|------------|---------|
| Incorrect manifest (no safety impact) | $250 per flight |
| Incorrect allergen information | $5,000 per incident |
| Missing nutritional information | $500 per incident |
| Repeated documentation errors (10+ per month) | $10,000 + audit |

### Section 4.14: KPI-13: Equipment Uptime

**Definition:** Percentage of time catering equipment (ovens, carts, warmers) operational

**Target:** ≥ 98% uptime

**Penalty Structure:**
| Downtime | Penalty |
|----------|---------|
| Single equipment failure < 4 hours | $500 |
| Equipment failure 4-12 hours | $2,500 |
| Equipment failure > 12 hours | $10,000 + contingency activation |
| Repeated failures (5+ per month) | $25,000 + equipment replacement mandate |

### Section 4.15: KPI-14: Emergency Response

**Definition:** Ability to respond to unscheduled flights, diversions, and delays

**Requirements:**
- 24/7 contact availability
- Response to emergency request within 30 minutes
- Delivery within 2 hours for emergency requests

**Penalty Structure:**
| Failure Type | Penalty |
|--------------|---------|
| No answer within 30 minutes | $1,000 |
| Unable to fulfill emergency request | $5,000 + lost profit |
| Repeated emergency failures (3+ per quarter) | $25,000 + review |

### Section 4.16: KPI-15: Sustainability Metrics

**Definition:** Compliance with sustainability requirements

**Requirements:**
- 50% of packaging biodegradable or recyclable by 2028
- 25% of ingredients locally sourced (within 200 miles)
- Food waste diversion rate ≥ 60%

**Penalty Structure:**
| Metric | Annual Target | Penalty for Non-Compliance |
|--------|---------------|---------------------------|
| Sustainable packaging | 50% by 2028 | $50,000 per year |
| Local sourcing | 25% | $25,000 per year |
| Waste diversion | 60% | $25,000 per year |

## ARTICLE V: PENALTY CALCULATION AND ENFORCEMENT

### Section 5.01: Penalty Calculation

All penalties calculated monthly based on previous month performance. Penalty calculation methodology:

**Step 1:** Identify KPI performance percentage/rate
**Step 2:** Compare against target threshold
**Step 3:** Apply penalty formula from relevant KPI section
**Step 4:** Sum all applicable penalties
**Step 5:** Apply any mitigating factors per Section 5.02

### Section 5.02: Mitigating Factors

Penalties may be reduced or waived for:

(a) **Force Majeure:** Events beyond Concessionaire control (weather, natural disaster, pandemic)
(b) **Airport-Caused Delays:** Airport infrastructure failure, security shutdowns
(c) **Airline-Caused Issues:** Late order submission, aircraft changes

**Reduction Schedule:**
| Mitigation Type | Penalty Reduction |
|-----------------|-------------------|
| Force Majeure | 100% waiver |
| Airport-caused | 75-100% reduction |
| Airline-caused | 50-75% reduction |
| First occurrence (no prior history) | 25% reduction |

### Section 5.03: Penalty Payment

(a) Penalties deducted from monthly invoices
(b) Disputed penalties: Escrow pending resolution
(c) Accumulated penalties > $100,000: Immediate payment required

### Section 5.04: Performance Improvement Plan

Triggered when:
- Any KPI scores "Unsatisfactory" for two consecutive months
- Three or more KPIs score "Deficient" in single month
- Total penalties exceed $75,000 in single quarter

**CAP Requirements:**
- Root cause analysis within 7 days
- Corrective actions within 15 days
- Weekly progress reports
- Target: Return to compliance within 60 days

---

## ARTICLE VI: REPORTING AND AUDIT

### Section 6.01: Daily Reporting

Concessionaire shall submit daily reports by 10:00 AM for previous day operations:
- Meals delivered by flight number
- On-time performance by flight
- Any service failures or incidents
- Temperature logs

### Section 6.02: Monthly Reporting

Monthly report due by 10th of following month:
- All KPI performance data
- Penalty calculations
- Passenger complaint summary
- Corrective action status

### Section 6.03: Quarterly Business Review

Quarterly meeting between Parties:
- Review KPI performance trends
- Discuss ongoing issues
- Identify improvement opportunities
- Approve corrective action plans

### Section 6.04: Audit Rights

Grantor may audit Concessionaire:
- Records: 7 years retention required
- Facilities: Unannounced visits permitted
- Food safety: HACCP compliance verification
- Financial: Invoice and pricing verification

---

## ARTICLE VII: TERMINATION

### Section 7.01: Termination for Cause

Grantor may terminate for:
- Three consecutive months of "Unsatisfactory" KPI performance
- Any food safety incident resulting in hospitalization
- Penalty accumulation exceeding $500,000 annually
- Material breach uncured after 30 days notice

### Section 7.02: Termination for Convenience

Grantor may terminate without cause:
- 180 days written notice
- Payment for non-cancelable commitments
- No penalty for early termination
